title: Remove confusing star icon from lyrics lines
description: There's a star icon appearing on some lyric lines (the 'wordsKnown' indicator) that shows when words in a line are known from other songs. This is confusing and not useful to users. Remove this star indicator entirely from LyricsDisplay.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Remove the star icon from lyric lines
Keep only 'default' and 'learned' states for lines
